summary: Iteration 9 — Progress Photo Timeline end-to-end. BACKEND (/app/backend/tests/test_progress_photos.py, 9/9 pass): auth-gated GET /api/progress/photos (401 unauth, 200 authed), POST /api/progress/photos multipart upload returns {id,url,date,weight,note} with no Mongo _id and url points to /api/files/..., authed GET of the returned url serves 200 image/png bytes while unauth is 401/403, invalid extension is rejected with 400, two photos with different dates are returned sorted asc by date, DELETE soft-removes (subsequent list excludes it) and deleting a nonexistent id returns 404, GET /api/progress (measurements) regression still 200. FRONTEND (Playwright 1440x900) as pwuser@example.com / Passw0rd!: /progress renders [data-testid=tab-measurements] + [data-testid=tab-photos] with measurements as default (log-progress-btn visible). Clicking tab-photos shows [data-testid=progress-photos] with add-photo-btn + toggle-compare-btn. Uploaded two PNGs via set_input_files on [data-testid=progress-photo-input] — modal [data-testid=photo-upload-modal] opened, filled photo-date-input/photo-weight-input/photo-note-input, clicked save-photo-btn, both cards appeared in [data-testid=photo-timeline] with img naturalWidth=32 and src containing /api/files/ (authenticated served images render). Compare mode: delete buttons hide, hint shows, clicking two cards renders [data-testid=compare-panel] with BEFORE/AFTER labels; close-compare-btn dismisses it. Delete: with compare off, [data-testid=delete-photo-{id}] click decreases count 2→1. Persistence: full page reload keeps 1 card. Measurements regression: log-progress-btn opens [data-testid=progress-modal], input-weight=73.2 saved via save-progress-btn (toast 'Progress saved.') and deleted. No console errors beyond expected pre-login 401 from /api/auth/me poll.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /api/progress/photos: `weight` is Form(str) and silently coerced with try/except → invalid weight strings become null with no client feedback. Consider 400 on non-numeric weight.

server.py POST /api/progress/photos accepts arbitrary `date` string, only slicing to 10 chars — no ISO date validation. A garbage date like 'xxxxx' would be persisted and sort ordering could be affected.
server.py DELETE /api/progress/photos only soft-deletes the doc and marks the file row deleted, but the object in Emergent object storage is never purged → storage grows unbounded over time.
ProgressPhotos.js: on upload failure `closeModal()` is not called and `previewUrl` object URL remains — memory leak if user cancels/retries repeatedly.

ProgressPhotos.js: `photos.reverse()` in the render creates reverse chronological order for display but server sorts ascending; this is fine, but the CompareBar sorts selPhotos ascending by date meaning BEFORE is always the older. Works, but non-obvious — worth a code comment.
server.py has grown past ~1500 lines; progress endpoints should live in routers/progress.py (repeats iter-7/8 modularization comment).
ProgressPhotos.js does not confirm before deletion — accidental clicks on the trash icon lose a photo immediately. Consider a confirm dialog.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (tabs + upload x2 + image render + compare + delete + reload persist + measurements regression)
